summary: Carefully executed preregistered paired controlled-fault study. Results support the primary estimand (guarded > baseline) with archived artifacts; preregistered harmful-overrepair aggregation was not produced by the archived confirmatory executor and is transparently treated as unresolved.
required_revisions: Provide a conventional IEEE-style numbered References section with full bibliographic metadata (authors, title, venue, year) for every cited work; do not use bare DOI/arXiv/identifier-only entries in the manuscript References.

Ensure inline citation markers in the prose are numeric IEEE-style and unambiguously map to the full metadata entries in References; verify and state in the manuscript that each numbered citation supports the specific nearby scholarly claim (fix any mismatches).

Explicitly confirm in Methods (brief sentence) that runtime model sampling parameters per archived model call are available in the evidence bundle and that temperature=null in execution/model_configuration.json is not evidence of temperature=0 (the manuscript already notes this, but add a single explicit pointer to the per-call sampling-record location in the archive).
optional_revisions: Consider condensing the Disclosure Statement to be more concise and avoid repeating technical execution accounting (keep the mandatory master-prompt locator and its SHA-256).
In Related Work, map each numbered citation to a one-line parenthetical summary of the specific empirical claim it supports to improve citation-semantic transparency for reviewers and readers.
